spec.title: Unused indexes (Non-PK)
spec.description:
Before dropping indexes make sure they are not used on replicas, if having any. FYI - one could also adjust the default 0 threshold so that "little used" indexes are shown.

Requires `reco_drop_index` metric.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  dbname as "Source Name",
  tag_data->>'table_full_name' as "Table Name",
  tag_data->>'object_name' as "Index Name",
  (data->>'index_size_b')::int8 as "Index size",
  0::int8 as "Scans"
FROM
  recommendations 
WHERE 
  time in (
    select max(time) 
    from recommendations 
    where $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) 
      and tag_data->>'reco_topic' = 'drop_index' and tag_data->>'issue_type' = 'unused' 
    group by dbname
  )
  AND dbname IN ($dbname) AND tag_data->>'reco_topic' = 'drop_index' and tag_data->>'issue_type' = 'unused'

SELECT
  dbname as "Source Name",
  tag_data->>'table_full_name' as "Table Name",
  tag_data->>'object_name' as "Index Name",
  (data->>'index_size_b')::int8 as "Index size"
FROM
  recommendations 
WHERE 
  time in (
    select max(time) 
    from recommendations 
    where $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) 
      and tag_data->>'reco_topic' = 'drop_index' and tag_data->>'issue_type' = 'invalid' 
    group by dbname
  )
  AND dbname IN ($dbname) AND tag_data->>'reco_topic' = 'drop_index' and tag_data->>'issue_type' = 'invalid'

spec.title: Missing Indexes
spec.description:
Adding indexes can have unexpected performance effects, so ensure that you test them first to verify that the recommendation has the desired effect.

Requires `reco_add_index` metric. 

Column Guide:
- **Sum. Avg Queries Exec Time**: the sum of the average execution time for all queries that should be optimized by this index.
- **Affected Queries**: all affected query ids to investigate further
- **Recommendation**: the recommended index ddl.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    dbname as "Source Name",
    tag_data->>'object_name' AS "Table Name",
    data->>'total_avg_exec_time' AS "Sum. Avg Exec Time",
    data->>'affected_query_ids' AS "Affected Queries",
    data->>'recommendation' AS "Recommendation"
FROM recommendations 
WHERE 
  time in (
    select max(time) 
    from recommendations 
    where time <= $__timeTo() AND dbname in ($dbname) and tag_data->>'reco_topic' = 'create_index' 
    group by dbname
  )
  AND dbname IN ($dbname) AND tag_data->>'reco_topic' = 'create_index' 
ORDER BY (data->>'total_avg_exec_time')::float8 DESC

value.title: Opens 'Table details' dashboard for this table

spec.rawSql:
with index_stats_changes as (
  select
  time,
  dbname,
  tag_data->>'index_full_name' as index_full_name,
  coalesce(CASE WHEN (data->>'idx_blks_read')::int8 >= lag((data->>'idx_blks_read')::int8) over w THEN (data->>'idx_blks_read')::int8 - lag((data->>'idx_blks_read')::int8) over w ELSE (data->>'idx_blks_read')::int8 END, 0) as blks_read
  from index_stats 
  where dbname in ($dbname) and $__timeFilter(time)
  window w as (partition by dbname, tag_data->>'index_full_name' order by time)
), top_indexes as (
  select
    dbname,
    index_full_name,
    sum(blks_read) as total_blks_read
  from index_stats_changes
  group by dbname, index_full_name
  order by total_blks_read desc
  limit $top
), blocks(size) as (
  select (data->>'value')::int8
  from settings_num
  where tag_data->>'name' = 'block_size'
    and time <= $__timeTo()
  order by time desc
  limit 1
)

select 
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  sum(blks_read) * (select size from blocks) as blks_read,
  dbname || ' ' || index_full_name as metric
from index_stats_changes
where dbname in (select dbname from top_indexes)
and index_full_name in (select index_full_name from top_indexes)
group by 1, dbname, index_full_name
order by 1, dbname, index_full_name

with index_stats_changes as (
  select
  time,
  dbname,
  tag_data->>'index_full_name' as index_full_name,
  coalesce(CASE WHEN (data->>'idx_blks_hit')::int8 >= lag((data->>'idx_blks_hit')::int8) over w THEN (data->>'idx_blks_hit')::int8 - lag((data->>'idx_blks_hit')::int8) over w ELSE (data->>'idx_blks_hit')::int8 END, 0) as blks_hit
  from index_stats 
  where dbname in ($dbname) and $__timeFilter(time)
  window w as (partition by dbname, tag_data->>'index_full_name' order by time)
), top_indexes as (
  select
    dbname,
    index_full_name,
    sum(blks_hit) as total_blks_hit
  from index_stats_changes
  group by dbname, index_full_name
  order by total_blks_hit desc
  limit $top
), blocks(size) as (
  select (data->>'value')::int8
  from settings_num
  where tag_data->>'name' = 'block_size'
    and time <= $__timeTo()
  order by time desc
  limit 1
)

select 
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  sum(blks_hit) * (select size from blocks) as blks_hit,
  dbname || ' ' || index_full_name as metric
from index_stats_changes
where dbname in (select dbname from top_indexes)
and index_full_name in (select index_full_name from top_indexes)
group by 1, dbname, index_full_name
order by 1, dbname, index_full_name

spec.title: Top $top indexes by number of tuples read
spec.description: Tuples Read = Number of index entries returned by scans on this index

spec.rawSql:
with index_stats_changes as (
  select
  time,
  dbname,
  tag_data->>'index_full_name' as index_full_name,
  coalesce(CASE WHEN (data->>'idx_tup_read')::int8 >= lag((data->>'idx_tup_read')::int8) over w THEN (data->>'idx_tup_read')::int8 - lag((data->>'idx_tup_read')::int8) over w ELSE (data->>'idx_tup_read')::int8 END, 0) as tuples_read
  from index_stats 
  where dbname in ($dbname) and $__timeFilter(time)
  window w as (partition by dbname, tag_data->>'index_full_name' order by time)
), top_indexes as (

  from index_stats_changes
  group by dbname, index_full_name

)
select

spec.title: Top $top indexes by number of tuples fetched
spec.description: Tuples Fetched = Number of live rows fetched from the table by simple index scans using this index

spec.rawSql:
with index_stats_changes as (
  select
  time,
  dbname,
  tag_data->>'index_full_name' as index_full_name,
  coalesce(CASE WHEN (data->>'idx_tup_fetch')::int8 >= lag((data->>'idx_tup_fetch')::int8) over w THEN (data->>'idx_tup_fetch')::int8 - lag((data->>'idx_tup_fetch')::int8) over w ELSE (data->>'idx_tup_fetch')::int8 END, 0) as tuples_fetched
  from index_stats 
  where dbname in ($dbname) and $__timeFilter(time)
  window w as (partition by dbname, tag_data->>'index_full_name' order by time)
), top_indexes as (
  select
    dbname,
    index_full_name,
    sum(tuples_fetched) as total_tuples_fetched
  from index_stats_changes
  group by dbname, index_full_name
  order by total_tuples_fetched desc
  limit $top
)
select 
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  sum(tuples_fetched) as tuples_fetched,
  dbname || ' ' || index_full_name as metric
from index_stats_changes
where dbname in (select dbname from top_indexes)
and index_full_name in (select index_full_name from top_indexes)
group by 1, dbname, index_full_name
order by 1, dbname, index_full_name

SELECT
  dbname as "Source Name",
  tag_data->>'table_full_name' as "Table Name",
  (data->>'index_size_b')::int8 as "Max Index size",
  data->>'duplicate_count' as "Num of duplicates",
  data->>'oids' as "OIDs",
  data->>'index_def' as "Index def"
FROM
  recommendations 
WHERE 
  time in (
    select max(time) 
    from recommendations 
    where $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) 
     and tag_data->>'reco_topic' = 'drop_index' and tag_data->>'issue_type' = 'duplicate' 
    group by dbname
  )
  AND dbname IN ($dbname) AND tag_data->>'reco_topic' = 'drop_index' and tag_data->>'issue_type' = 'duplicate'

WITH index_scan_changes AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    dbname,
    tag_data ->> 'index_full_name' AS index_full_name,
    tag_data ->> 'table_full_name' AS table_full_name,
    (data ->> 'idx_scan')::int8 - LEAD((data ->> 'idx_scan')::int8) OVER w AS idx_scans,
    (data ->> 'index_size_b')::int8 AS index_size_b,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER w AS rn
  FROM
    index_stats
  WHERE
    dbname IN ($dbname)
  WINDOW w AS (
    PARTITION BY dbname,
      tag_data ->> 'table_full_name',
      tag_data ->> 'index_full_name'
    ORDER BY time DESC
  )
),
total_scans AS (
  SELECT
    dbname,
    table_full_name,
    index_full_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(idx_scans, 0)) AS total_idx_scans,
    MAX(index_size_b) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS latest_index_size
  FROM
    index_scan_changes
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY
    dbname, table_full_name, index_full_name
)
SELECT
  dbname AS "Source Name",
  index_full_name AS "Index Name",
  table_full_name AS "Table Name",
  latest_index_size AS "Index Size",
  total_idx_scans AS "Scans"
FROM
  total_scans
ORDER BY
  latest_index_size DESC
LIMIT $top
